svg.title: SURMOUNT-5: share of people reaching each weight-loss goal
svg.desc: SURMOUNT-5: share of people reaching each weight-loss goal. At least 10% weight loss: tirzepatide 81.6%, semaglutide 60.5%. At least 15%: tirzepatide 64.6%, semaglutide 40.1%. At least 20%: tirzepatide 48.4%, semaglutide 27.3%. At least 25%: tirzepatide 31.6%, semaglutide 16.1%.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 751 adults with obesity, no diabetes, 72 weeks, open-label. Highest tolerated dose of each drug.
